fullDescription: A high-performance brutalist-glassmorphism style guide featuring a dark-mode palette (#0a0a0a), vibrant neon accents (cyan #00d9ff, pink #ff006e), and heavy editorial typography (Aspekta). This design system is optimized for creative technology portfolios, SaaS pricing pages, and fintech dashboards. It utilizes a bento grid layout for project showcases, 3D CSS transforms for interactive elements, and Framer Motion for staggered entrance animations. The aesthetic combines industrial brutalism (heavy borders, sharp typography) with futuristic glassmorphism (backdrop blurs, neon glows).
prompt:
## Resumo
A creative developer portfolio and interactive pricing system utilizing high-contrast dark mode, neon gradients, and brutalist layouts with glassmorphism components.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using a dark-mode foundation. Primary background: #0a0a0a; Secondary surface: #141414; Accents: Cyan (#00d9ff), Pink (#ff006e), and Purple (#b537f2). Typography: Use 'Aspekta' (or a similar geometric sans-serif). Hero headings should be 10vw, weight 900, tracking-tighter with line-height 0.9. Labels must be uppercase, tracking-widest (0.3em), size 12px. Interactive components should use glassmorphism: background rgba(20, 20, 20, 0.7), backdrop-filter blur(24px), and 1px border rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1). Buttons: Primary is solid white/black text, Secondary is border-only (1px solid white/20). Animations: Implement smooth y-axis entry (y: 20 to 0) with opacity 0 to 1 using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). Include neon glow effects (box-shadow: 0 0 40px) on featured elements.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed 80px height bar. Glassmorphism effect (blur 24px, bg-opacity 70%). Left side: Square logo with gradient background. Center: Text links (uppercase, tracking-wide, 14px). Right side: Solid white CTA button with arrow icon.

### Hero Section
Min-height 100vh. Two-column grid (50/50). Left: Large editorial text (Weight 900), cyan-to-pink text gradient for emphasis, status pill with pulse animation. Right: 3D rotating CSS cube (280px) with backdrop-filtered faces and neon icons inside. Scroll indicator at bottom center.

### Bento Grid Portfolio
Display work using a CSS grid with `auto-rows-[320px]` and 4 columns. Use `col-span-2` and `row-span-2` to create visual hierarchy. Each card: #141414 background, 1px border white/10, hover scale 1.02. Elements include index numbers (01, 02), project title, and category tags with border-only styling.

### Interactive Pricing
Centered container. Header with 7xl weight-900 heading. Toggle switch: rectangular, border white/10, active state is solid white with black text. Three-tier card layout. The center card (Professional) must be scaled to 1.05, feature a 'Most Popular' gradient badge, and a purple outer glow (#b537f2). Cards include Lucide-style icons in square frames and checkmark feature lists.

### Contact Form
Split layout. Left: Large 'Let's Create' heading with text links for email/socials featuring border-only icon boxes. Right: Form inside a #141414 surface container. Inputs: Background-transparent, bottom-border only (white/20), focus state cyan border transition.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### 3D Interactive Cube — A purely CSS-driven 3D rotating cube used as a hero visual.
Construct a 280px cube using `transform-style: preserve-3d`. Each of the 6 faces should have: border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,217,255,0.08), rgba(255,0,110,0.08)). Add an animation `rotate3d` that spins from 0deg to 360deg on the Y-axis continuously over 24 seconds.

### Neon Toggle Switch — A minimalist binary switch for monthly/annual pricing selection.
Create an inline-flex container with 1.5px border white/10 and backdrop-blur. Buttons inside should be 14px font-weight 600. Active state: bg-white, text-black. Inactive state: text-white/60. Include a 'SAVE 20%' badge on the right side with a cyan-to-pink gradient background.

### Glow Pricing Card — A glassmorphism card with a distinct outer neon glow for featured tiers.
Card styling: background #0f0f0f at 80% opacity, border 2px solid rgba(181, 55, 242, 0.5). Add `box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(181, 55, 242, 0.3)` and an inset shadow of the same color at 0.05 opacity. On hover, increase box-shadow to 60px and translate Y -8px.

style.description: The style is defined by a deep black background (#0a0a0a) contrasted with sharp cyan (#00d9ff) and pink (#ff006e) accents. It uses the Aspekta variable font for a sophisticated technical feel, ranging from weight 900 for hero headers to weight 300 for body text. Key elements include 1px translucent borders, heavy backdrop blurs (24px), and cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) transition curves. Animation is central, featuring 3D rotations, floating keyframes, and staggered scroll-triggered reveals.
